brief.t: START HERE: Open the known AT&T account ending 0434 and check payment or arrangement status before any service suspension.

ACT NOW 1: Verify AT&T balance before service suspension. October 24 warning lists $114.55 past due and $222.98 total for account ending 0434, requesting immediate payment. Notice is 1 day old; original due date and suspension date are not stated. Current payment/arrangement and affected service are unverified. Send internally: Please check AT&T account ending 0434 today and confirm the affected service, whether the past due balance is already paid or covered by an arrangement, and the action needed to prevent suspension. Cure deadline is November 5 at 6 pm Eastern. Sent Items verifies an inquiry to Jake at LIMN yesterday at 7:13 am Eastern; no newer reply in reviewed inbox. Send internally: Please match the IPFS installment to our payment records today and confirm whether Jake has verified the balance and active coverage before we make any payment.

ACT NOW 3: Protect Oreka sample deadline. SenoCellTec confirmation shows November 3 while Nadia’s Canada window ends November 1. Sent Items verifies Mibelle expedite/date/payment-application inquiry sent yesterday at 7:13 am Eastern; no fresh supplier reply reviewed. Michael’s October 23 request is 2 days old and Nadia task due October 14 is 11 days overdue. Send internally: Michael and Evelyn, the Mibelle expedite request is already sent but the November 3 date still conflicts with Nadia’s November 1 Canada window; please confirm a feasible sample plan today.
